_comment: Which real DSE item is shown on which Book 1 page, and the syllabus outcomes (verbatim C&A Guide wording, as listed in that page's Goals block) it tests. build_snapshot.py reads this.

outcomes.hot: realise temperature as the degree of hotness of an object
outcomes.avg: interpret temperature as a quantity associated with the average kinetic energy due to the random motion of molecules in a system
outcomes.prop: explain the use of temperature-dependent properties in measuring temperature
outcomes.cel: define and use degree Celsius as a unit of temperature
outcomes.heat: realise that heat is the energy transferred as a result of the temperature difference between two objects
outcomes.ie: describe the effect of mass, temperature and state of matter on the internal energy of a system
outcomes.kepe: relate internal energy to the sum of the kinetic energy of random motion and the potential energy of molecules in the system
outcomes.means: identify the means of energy transfer in terms of conduction, convection and radiation
outcomes.cond: interpret energy transfer by conduction in terms of molecular motion
outcomes.ir: realise the emission of infra-red radiation by hot objects
outcomes.rad: determine the factors affecting the emission and absorption of radiation
outcomes.C: define heat capacity as \( C = \dfrac{Q}{\Delta T} \) and specific heat capacity as \( c = \dfrac{Q}{m\Delta T} \)
outcomes.det: determine the specific heat capacity of a substance
outcomes.water: discuss the practical importance of the high specific heat capacity of water
outcomes.solve: solve problems involving heat capacity and specific heat capacity
